questions.question: What is retrieval-augmented generation?
questions.answer: RAG retrieves external evidence at request time and supplies it to a model before generation. It helps answer from changing or private information without retraining model weights; its quality still depends on retrieval and evidence use.

questions.question: What are the main stages of a RAG pipeline?

questions.question: When would you choose RAG over fine-tuning?

questions.question: What is an embedding?
